,.description: User-Agent string sent to HTTP servers.

ignore_robots.description: If true, check URLs regardless of any robots.txt files (maps to --no-robots).

ignore_url.description: List of regular expression patterns. URLs matching these are only syntax checked (--ignore-url). Items is a string regex pattern.

no_follow_url.description: List of regular expression patterns. URLs matching these are checked but not recursed into (--no-follow-url). Items is a string regex pattern.

output_type.description: Console output type. Valid types: text, html, sql, csv, gml, dot, xml, sitemap, none, failures.

file_outputs.description: List of file output specifications (--file-output). Format: TYPE[/ENCODING][/FILENAME]. Items is a string.

verbose.description: If true, log all checked URLs, overriding --no-warnings.

no_status.description: If true, do not print URL check status messages.

cookiefiles.description: List of paths to cookie files (--cookiefile). Items is a string file path.

debug_loggers.description: List of debug logger names to activate (--debug). Available: cmdline, checking, cache, plugin, all.
